items.headline: Transformers in Practice — New Course from AMD VP
items.summary: DeepLearning.AI launches a new course taught by Sharon Zhou (VP of Engineering & AI at AMD) that dives deep into how transformers actually work. Learn token generation mechanics, why hallucinations happen, how attention and positional encoding function, and key optimization techniques (quantization, KV caching, flash attention) for GPU inference efficiency. Perfect for understanding both model behavior and system-level deployment decisions.
